notes.title: Some nice features (and a performance boost)
notes.content:
Hello! It has been a while.

I realised I never included an update log for updates 1.09 and 1.10 (and today 1.10.1) so here is what has changed with those updates!

[u]Update 1.09[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed seam in track
[list]
[*] This was caused by the shadow of the track, and so shadows have been disabled for certain parts of the track and should be less noticeable
[/list]
[*] Lighting changes made to all tracks
[list]
[*] Lighting is now less harsh/bright to make the environment pop out more, but the track is still visible
[/list]
[*] Changed hover effect
[list]
[*] Should have less of a performance hit now and is now simplified
[/list]
[*] Added a new player model to the interior of the car
[list]
[*] The car is no longer being driven by a ghost
[/list]
[*] Fixed leaderboards not updating when changing level
[*] Fixed the incorrect count for total leaderboard entries
[*] World best times now shown on the level select
[*] Removed old main menu theme from playing
[*] Added new speed indicator
[list]
[*] This indicator can be flipped to either side depending on preference
[/list]
[/list]

[u]Update 1.10[/u]
[list]
[*] Added pop-up for when off-road for too long to tell you how to reset the car to the previous 
          checkpoint
[*] Improved performance for shadows
[*] Changed RHI from directx12 to directx11
[list]
[*] This should help with shadow performance and there was other issues with directx12
[*] This has meant that lighting has needed to be rebuilt
[*] Updated car model
[list]
[*] This new car model has a similar look to the older one, but with less of a performance hit (the game can now run stably at 60fps on a Steam Deck with shadows enabled)
[/list]
[/list]

[u]Update 1.10.1[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed replay pause menu creating multiple copies of itself when the pause key was pressed several times
[*] Fixed world best times not showing correctly in the level select menu (it only showed after changing the selected level)
[*] Added more variety to tree colouration for Forest_Run
[/list]

Right now I am hard at work getting all the multiplayer side of the game working as when it was last tested (over 1.5 years ago!) it worked fine (mostly), however a lot has changed over that time so testing is needed to ensure it still works (don't worry, split-screen still works! That was tested at a local playtesting event 4 months ago and the game underwent fixes). 

As well as creating new and exciting racetracks (with layout and "feel" being the first thing I typically design and test before going with a visual theme) there is plenty more to show off with Take The Wheels! in the future. As of writing, there are currently 14 tracks with layouts done and of those 14, 8 have partially completed visual decoration! (although because I am primarily a programmer, visually it will have a long way to come!). A few tracks that were created for the build of the game over 3 years ago are also being re-designed for the current movement for the car (the car was originally much grippier and less engaging to drive). 

Otherwise, it has been amazing seeing so many times being set in the game (as of writing this, there are 98 times set currently across all tracks) and feedback of the game has been amazing to receive!

Thank you all very much!

notes.title: Now watch this drive
notes.content:
Hello all! 
Releasing a new update for the Take The Wheels! demo today! Featuring some new and improved replay functionality, as well as much more improved navigation of the UI with a controller! So you no longer need to rely on using your mouse to move through menus before you start racing!

Check out the changes below!
[list]

	[*] Updated foliage
[list]
		[*] No longer has a full bright/unlit look anymore
		[*] No longer has the hologram effect
[/list]
	[*] Toggle HUD option made more clear
[list]
		[*] There is now a checkbox that also affects all HUD elements, including the checkpoint indicator
[/list]
	[*] Changed square/X to be used for boost
[list]
		[*] Circle/B is now used for change camera
		[*] R1 is still used for boost (this change is for people using the triggers to accelerate)
[/list]
	[*] Settings can be adjusted with the controller now
[list]
		[*] (like graphics settings and stuff)
[/list]
	[*] Clicking back into the game now keeps the controller cursor input instead of losing it
	[*] Added glow to the track edge
[list]
		[*] This is to help with track readability
[/list]
	[*] Added new orbiting spectator functionality
[list]
		[*] This lets you keep a fixed distance from cars when spectating them (similar to an orbiting 3rd person camera in some games)
[/list]
	[*] Changed the spectator UI layout
[list]
		[*] Added text options on what some keys now do, as well as a new way to change who you are spectating
[/list]
[*]Fixed car not having the correct colour when racing
[/list]

Other than that, more is being worked on for the full release of the game (which is why the replay interface has changed slightly)

Keep setting those blisteringly fast lap times, and perfecting your control of the car in Take The Wheels!

notes.title: Groovin, Movin, and Zoomin
notes.content:
Demo update 1.07 is here! And with some great changes to vehicle handling, the music, track layouts and more, this is the update to play!

Check out the detailed update changes below!

	• Added new main menu theme
		○ There is now a 1 in 5 chance of the old theme playing
	• Adjusted hovercar movement
	• Changed respawning to start line to restart countdown from 1 second
		○ Gives time to ready self again finger positioning wise on controller
	• New thruster visual effects
		○ The old effects made it hard to tell which rocket was active sometimes. These ones are much more "glued" to the car model
		○ They are also updated to show which effect is active on the car (e.g. thrust, off-road etc.)
	• New hover particle visual effects
		○ Similar to above, but with the hovering particles
	• Changed directional arrow indicator to be above the car
		○ When in front/bonnet camera, it changes to the front of the car
	• Changed the boost powerup to give additional grip when active
		○ This allows for powering out of corners and being able to take corners at a much faster speed
	• Fixed being able to have a powerup on reset
	• Added additional checkpoints to TrackDay03
		○ This was done to make it easier for players to determine where to go
			§ …and has had the side effect of making the track faster because of additional boosts added to each odd numbered checkpoint
	• Fixed a bug where it was possible to pass one checkpoint then backtrack to the start line and it count as finishing the track
	• Redesigned parts of the layout of Forest_Run to be more smooth with the adjusted hovercar movement
		○ Based on feedback provided by players, slow tracks are nowhere near as fun as fast tracks, so Forest_Run has had the layout adjusted to have more fast sections
	• Allowed for more replays to be recorded
		○ This has also changed the naming scheme of demos to be easier to find in the "Demos" folder
	• Fixed the leaderboard not displaying the correct track times
		○ Also fixed it not loading the times correctly on first load
	• Added leading zeros to the timer and times for the leaderboard
	• Removed some UI options
		○ Notably in leaderboards
	• Adjusted the joystick movement to be more forgiving for 100% thrust power
		○ You can now be slightly to the left/right when pushing up/down to get the same effect as full power
	• Added a new speedometer
		○ It functions the exact same as the old one, but more round
	• Decreased turning force when boost is active
		○ This should help with reducing overturning when you have the boost powerup active
	•Fixed a bug where it was possible to complete a track having only passed one checkpoint (if you passed the start line)
	• Changed how foliage looks in the tracks (and some other visuals)

So... what else has been worked on? It's been a while since the last big update to the game.

Well, great question! Truth is; quite a lot!

So recently Take The Wheels! was exhibited at a local convention and has had some more playtesting done, and, good news is that there was no major bugs or issues! (well... except for one, but that one was found by me and didn't effect the game at all. and actually got fixed in this update!)

Other than that, a fair few things under the hood have changed, as well as some testing of split-screen play! Which works... mostly. It still has some refinement to go through with visuals for UI and whatnot, but it's coming along well!

So keep setting blistering lap times! As because of changes to both the movement and the TrackDay03 map, there is plenty of optimisation to go!

notes.title: A new track to master!
notes.content:
Hello all!
Time for a change of pace, and what better way to do that than with an all new track!
TrackDay03 is a fantastic short beginner track for familiarising yourself with the unique control scheme of Take The Wheels! and along with additional changes to the tutorial UI as well as other quality of life improvements, this latest update will help in making mastering Take The Wheels! a breeze! 

Check out the changes below:

• Change so that when respawning from start it resets the time back to 0:00
	○ Decide if starts countdown from 1 or just immediately give control
• Add in a new updated car model
• Added a new track
	○ TrackDay03 is a new short beginner friendly track set in a desert environment
• Added sound effect for passing checkpoints
	○ Also added unique sound effect for countdown/start
• Fixed the DevTest track uploading times when it shouldn’t have been
	○ As funny as it was seeing a time of approx. 2 seconds, it should not be uploading times
• Removed reset freeze delay
	○ You are no longer frozen for 0.2 seconds upon resetting to a previous checkpoint
• Updated the Island_Hopping and Forest_Run tracks to have much more clearly defined track paths
	○ Because trying to tell what was onroad and what was offroad was far trickier beforehand and led to confusion
• Water has collision (again)!
	○ This was accidently removed when the engine version was updated!
• Out of order checkpoints no longer register if you pass through them
	○ So you can no longer accidentally go through the wrong checkpoint and be unable to finish a track
• Updated the game UI
	○ It now tells you how to use a powerup!
• Slightly adjusted bonnet camera location
• Added a new power indicator to the back of the car
	○ You can now tell how much throttle you have applied for each engine (in forward, reverse and boost!)
• Fixed camera change button on controller
	○ The input was being consumed by the "Next" action. This has now been fixed
• Triggers on controller now move a car forward again
• Slightly change the tutorial to hold down the thruster for approx. 1 second to ready up
• UI navigation fixes
• Added separate sound sliders for engine and sound effects (SFX)

notes.title: Demo Update 1.05.1
notes.content:
Hello!

Small changes to the game UI today to make the timer as well as checkpoint and lap text more visible as well as a bug fix for the tutorial UI where it was possible to have it stuck on for the duration of a race.

Other than that, Take The Wheels! has just been ported over to a newer version of the Unreal Engine, which is why the update is so massive today (sorry! I was informed of the bug just after the project had been ported). I've also been hard at work on a brand new short track that might be featured in an upcoming demo update! It has been great to see the attention that Take The Wheels! has been getting since update 1.05 dropped start of last week!

notes.title: Time for a new car, sounds and music!
notes.content:
Hello all! Big visibility, performance improvement and game related changes coming today. Brand new text, replay improvements, back-end changes and… NEW MODELS!!!!
[list]
	• Updated all the font in the game
[list]
		○ Using a new font face for all text to better fit the setting of the game
[/list]
	• Huge change to the back-end of the game
[list]
		○ What this means for players is that there is now an option in the "Solo" menu that allows for changing between either a player or a spectator before a race starts
[list]
			§ This may have something to do with the work in progress multiplayer
[/list]
[/list]
	• Performance improvements to replays
[list]
		○ Replays currently still stutter in the first few seconds of player movement but are drastically improved in game speed changes
		○ They also now more accurately project audio speed (whereas before they did not)
[/list]
	• Replays now follow a new naming scheme
[list]
		○ Replays are now named based on track and date/time
[/list]
	• Rendering changes to all tracks
[list]
		○ Each track should now be more vibrant
[/list]
	• You can now track your car in replays! Press "T" to toggle on car tracking.
[list]
		○ The camera can now track your car in a replay! So no longer will you have to hastily follow your car around and hope you got the shot you were looking for!
[/list]
	• Changed the trees on Forest_Run
[list]
		○ These trees should have a better performance improvement (and there are slightly fewer of them)
		○ They also have no shadows for the time being too, to help with performance
[/list]
	• Small terrain changes to Forest_Run
[list]
		○ These changes will have no physical impact on the driving experience and are just scenery
[/list]
	• Other changes that I have likely forgotten to note down

	• Updated the tutorial UI at the start to better illustrate the controls
[list]
		○ The game won't start until you try to go forward, even with "enable tutorial" disabled
[/list]
	• Added a new menu to the settings that allows for changing of game volume

	• Adding onto the above point, main menu music!
[list]
		○ Along with the new background for the main menu, this should make the main menu less… bland
[/list]
	• Colour change!
[list]
		○ Sure red makes you go faster, but maybe red isn't the colour you'd like for your car? Maybe something different like, say blue, or green? Or how about any colour you can think of!
		○ Worried that your car colour won't show when you load a demo? Don't worry! The game doesn't forget!
[list]
			§ (It also remember what colour your car was when you quit or select a new car colour!)
[/list]
[/list]
	• And most importantly of all…
[list]
		○ NEW CAR MODEL!!!
[list]
			§ This new car model has been created to better show how the car controls in the game. The original model had been a placeholder for a bit longer than I'd have liked, so this new model was created!
			§ There is also the possibility of new car types being trialed in the future (although this is to be tested to see how they performs with the vision of the game)
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

So… What has been worked on other than these demo updates for Take The Wheels!?

Well, I've been at work making new time trial and circuit tracks for the early access release, as well as making improvements to both the multiplayer as well as split-screen! Next thing to test is the powerups! When they were last tested over 2 years ago at a convention they all worked absolutely fine. However, with all the changes that the game has gone through since then, some of them have broken, whether that be for player targeting powerups (mostly those ones) or other bugs, I'd like to test them to see they are all still (mostly) working as intended and then can add in more for the Early Access release! I'll also be creating more tracks for the release as well, as currently there are 13 tracks that are in the current build of the game, but a small handful need to be reworked (as they were designed with the original, more grippy movement in mind and are incredibly difficult in the new handling model!), so that number ends up being closer to 8. Still, would love to release with even more tracks than 13!

Other than that, the demo update trailer for Take The Wheels! Is out now! so have a watch to see some of the new content that has been added! 

Keep setting those times! With all the movement changes to the car, it's possible to get below 2 minutes on Island_Hopping, so let's see some sub 2 minute times!

notes.title: Drifting is now king!
notes.content:
Hello! 
Today's update (Demo Update 1.04) features again, some further improved movement changes, with further reduced sideways friction to allow for smoother drifting as well as some new particles for the car, alongside some other quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

See the changelogs below for the changes made!

• Fixed bug when going from airborne to water it could set thrust force to zero
	○ This bug also occurred when boosting while airborne and landing on water
• Heavily adjusted movement again to make more drifty
	○ You are now punished even less for racing with a more drifty style
	○ This may have had the side effect of increasing the top speed of the car (due to changes made to 
            make the car more drifty, so expect faster track times now!)
• Added a new developer level to test the car in different environments, including a slalom, several jumps and a loop
	○ The loop and ramps are very jittery with the car right now
• Modified the speed indicator to me more accurate with the car's actual current speed
	○ Before, it would show ~90% as the car's top speed
• Changes to the UI
	○ Completing a time trail track now says "Finished!" instead of "1st!"
	○ If online your position on the leaderboard as well on the "leaderboard position" screen
		§ It will also show if you improved on your time too 
	○ Changed the tutorial UI to have less visual clutter
		§ See here for what it looks like now!
• Adjusted the Forest Run track to have less visual "bounce" on the track
	○ There are no more "potholes" on the track now

These movement changes today also mean it's possible to break some new track records! So give it a crack today and see if you can be number 1 in both Island Hopping and Forest Run! (sub 2 minutes on Island Hopping is now very much possible!)

notes.title: Handles like a dream!
notes.content:
Today's update features a very noteworthy change in the handling of the car. With changes to airborne movement, water movement as well as general vehicle handing, you'll (hopefully!) find the car more rewarding to handle around sharp corners and long turns alike.

Below is a more detailed list of what exactly has changed in this update (not just the handling changed with today's update)

[h2]Hovercar[/h2]
[h3]Handling[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted hovercar handling to be far more forgiving when airborne
[list]
[*] You will lose much less speed when airborne and not in contact with any surface
[/list]
[*] Adjusted hovercar handling to have less friction when sliding sideways
[list]
[*] This is to encourage more "drifty" turning around corners
[/list]
[*] Adjustments made to on-water handling characteristics of the hovercar
[list]
[*] It is now less punishing if you go on the water now (slightly faster plus a small window of keeping original top speed)
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Physics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an uncommon/rare case where it was possible for the hovercar to pass through the terrain of tracks at a high velocity or at certain angles
[list]
[*] This was most common on ramps, and has been fixed with more checks done with the physics. Note: This may have the side effect of lowering performance.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Tracks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added more visual detail to both Island Hopping and Forest Run
[/list]
[h2]Replays[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new UI element that allows for changing the speed of the replay camera
[/list]

More work is being done on the game. All the feedback helps greatly with the development of the game, so keep it coming!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.02
notes.content:
Hello! Small update for the Take The Wheels! demo today. Some minor changes made to the vehicle camera as well as control changes to the car to make it more sticky to the ground (less bouncy on landings)

- Camera now has small amount of lag behind the car when in motion (and turning)
- Changes made to the loading effect during the countdown
- Countdown decreased from 5 seconds to 3 seconds
- Changes made to car to make it more grounded and sticky.
+ It should feel less bouncy when landing from heights.

More work is currently being done on some new tracks for the Early Access release of Take The Wheels! so keep an eye out!

notes.title: Now again in slow motion
notes.content:
Hello!
It's been a while since the demo was launched back in September.
Well, I have been working on this for a while now and can now happily say that replays have now been added to Take The Wheels! There have been a couple of other minor bug fixes and improvements that are listed below as well!

[list]
[*] New menu to allow you to watch replays of times you've set!
[list]
[*] By default, the game will record all track completions (from start of the countdown to the passing of the finish line)
[*] This can be disabled in the main menu
[/list]
[*] Adjusted the leaderboards menu to allow you to see the top times as well as times near you.
[*] Adjustments made to the game HUD
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible to give yourself double the speed on a controller
[*] Menu visibility has been adjusted for dropdown menus
[*] New level loading effect added
[/list]
There is more content being planned for this demo, so do keep an eye out!

Follow progress of the game on X (formally Twitter): https://twitter.com/MisdirectStudio
